concept: Covered concourse spotlight adjustment with fitted base and loose coat
reference_role: visible face and hair appearance only

gates.expected: The same opaque one-piece follows torso, waist and hip contours through readable shaped seams and small tension folds.
Solid textile covers chest, abdomen and pelvis continuously.
A separate loose tan coat has outward front edges, broad folds and clear draping distance from the fitted base.
Adult face is readable, with visible short dark bob and airy bangs broadly consistent with the portrait reference; this does not establish identity.
The right hand turns the exterior brass yoke tilt knob, lamp stands beside her, torso is balanced over legs.
Face, fitted torso/waist/hips, both outer coat edges and operative hand coexist visibly in head-through-knees framing.
